sql: SELECT strategy, date_trunc('hour', created_at) hr, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cancel_reason ILIKE '%insufficient%') insuf, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('resting','filled','canceled','partial')) ok, round(sum(limit_price*quantity) FILTER (WHERE cancel_reason ILIKE '%insufficient%')/100.0,2) insuf_usd FROM live_orders WHERE created_at > '2026-09-20' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE cancel_reason ILIKE '%insufficient%') > 0 ORDER BY 2,1
